info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Rooms Inventorys-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Rooms Inventory Retrieval API provides access to the current inventory of hotel rooms, allowing users to efficiently query available rooms and their details. This endpoint supports typical operations for hoteliers, property managers, and booking platforms to monitor and manage room availability in real-time. By leveraging this API, applications can enhance their booking processes, optimize occupancy, and improve customer satisfaction through accurate inventory representation. Use cases include integrating room availability into booking systems and providing up-to-date data for travel agencies.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current inventory of rooms available. You can use this information to check room availability, types, and other relevant details for your applications.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the inventory of rooms. This body should contain necessary filters, criteria, or parameters to specify the inventory details you wish to receive.

200.description: Returns the available rooms inventory successfully.
